def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])

    if not (0 <= start[0] < rows and 0 <= start[1] < cols and
            0 <= goal[0] < rows and 0 <= goal[1] < cols):
        return []

    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []

    if start == goal:
        return [start]

    q = [(start, [start])]
    visited = {start}

    while q:
        (row, col), path = q.pop(0)

        if (row, col) == goal:
            return path

        neighbors = [(row - 1, col), (row + 1, col), (row, col - 1),
                     (row, col + 1)]

        for nr, nc in neighbors:
            if (0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and
                    grid[nr][nc] == '.' and (nr, nc) not in visited):
                q.append(((nr, nc), path + [(nr, nc)]))
                visited.add((nr, nc))

    return []

def solve(grid, start, goal):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    path = []

    def is_valid(row, col):
        return 0 <= row < rows and 0 <= col < cols and grid[row][col] == '.' and (row, col) not in visited

    def find_path(row, col):
        if (row, col) == goal:
            path.append((row, col))
            return True

        if not is_valid(row, col):
            return False

        visited.add((row, col))
        path.append((row, col))

        # Explore neighbors
        if find_path(row + 1, col) or \
           find_path(row - 1, col) or \
           find_path(row, col + 1) or \
           find_path(row, col - 1):
            return True

        # Backtrack
        path.pop()
        return False

    if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '#' or grid[goal[0]][goal[1]] == '#':
        return []

    if start == goal:
        if grid[start[0]][start[1]] == '.':
            return [start]
        else:
            return []

    if find_path(start[0], start[1]):
        return path
    else:
        return []
